text:
Ava: Noticed a support ticket: saved queries don't change when you switch from route view to model view. Feels unexpected.

Tom: We currently fetch saved queries by route_id only. No model scope.

Rina: Product question: should model view auto-switch saved query scope? I'm leaning no (avoid surprises) but make switching obvious.

Megan (Design): Proposal: keep default as route-scoped. Add a small "scope" chip next to the route header: Route ▾. Clicking -> Route / Model / Team / Global. If user selects Model, call /api/savedqueries?model_id=xxx and show model-tagged views first.

Tom: Backend: easy add. Need nullable model_id column on saved_queries and index (route_id, model_id). Backfill can be lazy.

Diego: Telemetry note: when model scope selected, cost-preview must use per-model cost profile and serve-attribution window. Eng-ML will need to expose that stream.

Ava: UX edgecase: fallbacks. If runtime served v1 but route intent is v2, show a small badge: "served: v1 (fallback)" and offer "view by served model" that toggles scope and updates cost-preview.

deploy-bot: [deploy] console v2.9.2: savedqueries search canary at 3% https://ci.redwood/console/1402

Tom: Action items: DB RFC for model_id (I'll draft), API param support (Tom + Rina), design mocks for scope chip and coverage badge (Megan), telemetry API for serve attribution (Diego).

Megan (Design): I'll add microcopy for coverage explanation and a tiny prototype. Tagging this thread when done. :sparkles:
